name: Parivaar Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)
benefit: The scheme provides 50% of the pension amount or a maximum of ₹ 500/- to the family members of the deceased pensioner.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of the deceased pensioner.
   1. The deceased pensioner should have been a resident of Jharkhand.
   1. The deceased pensioner should have been receiving a pension from the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board at the time of their death.
